newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures slip, spot Jan expires higher.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures slip, spot Jan expires higher.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended weaker on Monday with bearish sentiment carried over from last Friday, as the market failed to gain after the spot January contract expired higher at noon, traders said.

The spot January contract expired at noon at 142.0 yen per kg, up from 139.5 yen. There were 473 lots of deliveries. Other contracts ranged from 0.4 yen to 1.4 yen weaker, with most-active benchmark June ending down 0.5 yen at 144.0 yen.
"Private investors have been putting their money to more volatile other commodities like grain, after closing positions in rubber futures," one trader said.
